fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Execution of plink to perform data exfiltration and tunneling
fields.name: Potential RDP Tunneling Via Plink
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\plink.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains ":127.0.0.1:3389") or ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\plink.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains ":3389") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -P 443" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -P 22"))))
